scope: Data blocks measured by scripts/title_link.py. Units that own no function rows are compiled from here and linked at link_before; units with function rows keep their code-order position.

units.evidence: evidence/title_closure.json (unit 0x17cb0 data: slot table and its paths)

ordering: Objects link in code order (lowest owned function RVA). A data unit sorts at link_before: just before the object whose code starts at that RVA.
